narration: DRAFT_BOX_NARRATION.txt (existing approved ElevenLabs Adam take and original word timings; never regenerate for creative changes)
styleRules: Match actual Episode 01 Remotion/THREE.js rig, grade, ink, character silhouettes, environment and camera grammar.
Show, do not tell: animate EVERY verb/physical consequence; avoid stationary box or cat portraits as a substitute for acting.
All motions physically plausible: planted paws, cat mouth/nose grasps, valid jump arcs and flap hinge, no card/box clipping.
Use cinematic crane, motivated POV, varied tracking, emotional reaction, depth of field; avoid repetitive alley frames.
Use established café with two counters and Episode 01 house, bus stop and street; furnish real market and three distinct alleys.
Objects keep identity, size, color and position: Latte striped box under café window, Essie intact four-sided box, genuine soft cat bed, final shared box.
Acted town crowds and busy backgrounds in relevant shots, no static or explanatory cure billboard.
